ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Name an organism that is a carnivore.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a food web, labeled Algae, Tadpole, Small fish, Water Beetle, Snail, Frog, and Kingfisher. Arrows point from Small fish to Kingfisher, and also from Frog to Kingfisher, indicating that Kingfisher eats Small fish and Frog. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate from food/prey to predator. A carnivore is an organism that eats other animals. Kingfisher eats small fish and frog, which are both animals, so Kingfisher is a carnivore.
